text: A number of residents on Danville Drive have contacted me to share their concerns about speed and volume issues on their street. Residents regularly observe vehicles operating at speeds well beyond the posted limit of 50km/h. Danville Drive is a residential street with many families and children walking to and from the nearby Owen Park, Owen Public School, and St. Andrew's Middle School.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Danville Drive, between Upper Highland Crescent and Fenn Avenue.
